{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Reform & Revolution is a Marxist caucus in DSA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is being built into a force capable of carrying out a socialist transformation of society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A revolution is intended to smash the capitalist state and build a workers’ state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group stands in the revolutionary tradition of Marxism and scientific socialism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group draws inspiration from the ideas of Marx, Engels, Luxemburg, Lenin, Trotsky, and other revolutionaries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group's strategy emerges from the lessons of the 1917 Bolshevik Revolution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In the 1917 Bolshevik Revolution, the working class seized state power and used it to transform society in its own interests and the interests of humanity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group continues to build upon the tradition of the Left Opposition and Trotskyism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The fragmentation and disorientation of Marxist forces poses a challenge for the revolutionary left.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The bureaucratic ossification and collapse of the Soviet Union poses a challenge for the revolutionary left.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The growth of new left formations and new terrains of class struggle present enormous opportunities.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The current period is characterized by crises of organization, leadership, and consciousness, which together form a Triple Crisis.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"R&R aims to tackle the Triple Crisis by carrying out a Dual Task.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Dual Task involves simultaneously building mass campaigns and broader socialist organizations, while also developing the revolutionary core within those struggles.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
